## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record relevant checks and evidence, including any limits on what was verified.

## README accuracy and documentation

For changes to public behavior, APIs, supported inputs, setup, defaults,
validation claims, licensing or README text, apply the
[README accuracy policy](https://github.com/sankar-ramamoorthy/rag-foundry-universal/blob/main/DOCS/standards/readme-accuracy.md).

- [ ] README product claims and limitations match the implementation,
      configuration defaults and relevant validation evidence. Updated the
      README, or explained why it remains accurate.
- [ ] Milestones, issues and progress/validation updates are in `DOCS/status.md`;
      the README links to status rather than duplicating development updates.
- [ ] Applicable examples, local links and project license declarations checked
      against configuration/API contracts and `LICENSE` (Apache-2.0).
